status: Post-hoc amendment made after all eight group-five target bounds failed and before any group-six launch
reason: Full-population Lloyd updates on group six would repeat hundreds of billions of comparisons; use a fixed public training sample for design and a full exact population pass once per final descriptor
sample_law: Uniform without replacement, xorshift32 seed 0x243f6a88, sorted unique 24-bit source words; same fixed sample for both starts
proposal_weights: Training cell counts multiplied by 128 to sum to 16^6; remain public proposal weights, not asserted true population counts
complete_population_grading: Exact integer price rule on all 16777216 sources; store actual population CDF counts and complete map
native_array_workspace: Persistent cost/mapping arrays plus transient training/source uniqueness buffers remain below 256 MiB; allocator/library/stack/RSS overhead separate
native_original_workspace_field: The original native field is a base-array estimate; it omits the transient uniqueness bitmap. Independent metadata adds that bitmap conservatively.
training_metrics: Exploratory, not true population entropy/error or independent held-out model trials
information_contract: Original public-table, parent/child and forbidden-channel contract unchanged
